{{Quote|They shipped me to Akrit'tar. After three months I managed to escape from the penal colony there and made my way back to the Alliance.|[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
'''Akrit'tar''' was an inhospitable,<ref name="CATCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> barren and lifeless [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was an [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world for the safe keeping of political enemies of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Of the many residents of Akrit'tar's prisons one of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] former smuggling associates, [[Tregga/Legends|Tregga]], was sentenced to a life of hard labor after being caught with a smuggled cargo of [[Chak-root/Legends|chak-root]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] was also held here after a failed attempt at "brainwashing," on the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', escaping three months later.
